notes.title: 06.27.24: Patch Update 08
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983366/999bf444ba829f833783d7c1d92dd4f61ce4e4c7.png[/img]

[b]For Release Candidate 0.1.36[/b]
[h2]PATCHING UP YOUR ROMANCE[/h2]
As we launched the first version of our romance update, we knew there were some Quality of Life, as well as more necessary User Interface elements we wanted to include or tweak.  Now that the romance feature is in your hands, our first quick update is listed below.  Also we’ll be constantly on the lookout for suggestions, and would love to learn more about how you play your characters in conjunction with your combat companions.

[h2]ROMANCE UI UPDATE[/h2]
After you’ve leveled up your relationship with a character in Valorborn successfully, you unlock them as a combat ally.  You’ll now notice a new icon appearing in the bottom left corner of the screen when in battle!  This icon shows the character who’s about to arrive, and their heart color indicates the relationship level you’ve reached with them.  You can see more details when you talk to them in the Courtyard when you're not dealing with the undead.

The combat companion icon will show your unlocked combat ally, as well as a meter that gradually fills.  When the meter is full, your ally will appear in a flash of light and will fight by your side.  Note: Your combat companion will only be there for a short time, but will be back soon to help out in your assignments.  When you have more than one friend unlocked, they will take turns coming to your aid.  The more companions you unlock, and the deeper the relationship with each one, the more improved chance of appearing and being your combat helper.  So pay attention to those relationship meters back at the courtyard!

[h2]RELAX, DON’T FIGHT IT… OK MAYBE FIGHT IT![/h2]
We think that the combat companions will add an extra dimension to your exploration of the lands about Valorborn, as well as inject some energy, and survivability through the perilous night assignments.   Let us know what you think, and as always, we welcome your much valued suggestions to Necromantic!

notes.title: Major Update 01
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983366/e63f3c52fce4bb239fe3917420e35b9f9c071811.png[/img]
[h2]For Release Candidate 0.1.33[/h2]
Greetings to all you Necromantics.   We applaud your patience for all those who’ve been with us since our Early Access launch, and of course welcome to all our new Necromantics!  Blinkmoon Games is extremely grateful to our supporters and celebrate our first major update since late May!  Many of our fans (as well as ourselves of course!) have been wanting to venture more into the romance side of Necromantic.  We’ve been keen to open up our world, characters and lore to our audience, and this major update gives us an excellent opportunity to do so!  At its heart ❤️ (see what I did there), Necromantic is an action first game, so any game mechanic will naturally lean heavily into that, and the romance elements are no exception.  This is our first implementation of the feature, and we strive to react and adjust it depending upon your feedback, and our team's capabilities.

[h2][b]UPDATES[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The new romance feature, see the section below to learn more about how it works. 
[*] Note: For those who haven’t seen it yet, there is a new Yearbook with a bit of Necromantic lore and character art
[*] Updated help screen
[*] New diamond player indicator for conversations
[*] Lightning Damage has been increased
[*] Siren’s wail radius and Damage per second increased
[*] Minor text updates
[*] Notification popups for potions, health, and other buffs in game
[*] In game Gift crate indicator
[*] Many bug fixes ‘under the hood’ for stability
[/list]
[h2][b]HOW DOES THE ROMANCE FEATURE WORK?[/b][/h2]
In the Romance Feature update, we covered what the feature is all about.  To refresh on the romance loop:
[olist]
[*] Find Gift Crates when in combat and collect the gifts contained within 
[*] Give gifts to viable NPCs in the courtyard
[*] Fill a relationship meter between the character you are using and that NPC
[*] Fill the meter to marked thresholds to unlock an improved relationship with the NPC
[list]
[*] Their dialogue towards your character improves
[*] That NPC will come to that character’s aid in combat!
[/list][*] Continue giving gifts to fill the relationship meter to the next threshold, and the NPC becomes more powerful when they appear.
[/olist]
[h2][b]THANK YOU FOR YOUR CONTINUED SUPPORT[/b][/h2]
Thank you very much for the ongoing support and continued feedback. Please keep it coming via Steam and Discord.  We look forward to tuning and tweaking your experience at Valorborn, and wish you every success in keeping the ever growing hordes at bay.

notes.title: Developer Diaries: Entry 04
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983366/a163114e8a5152cafe0ca462f6edec5ccc9298f8.png[/img]
[h2][b]WE GREET YOU![/b][/h2]
Hello fellow Necromantics!  We are hard at work on our next major feature - Romance - and it's coming out very soon.  So soon in fact, that the first iteration of the Romance feature will be in the game by the end of June. 

[h2][b]SO WHAT'S THIS ROMANCE FEATURE?[/b][/h2]
Romance is a combination of narrative character development, item collection and turn in, and combat boosts in Single Player gameplay.  If you like to get to know the characters and their backstories, this is the beginning of that.  If you want more power when you’re in a fight, this helps there too.

Through our new Romance feature, you can interact with the main cast of characters of Valorborn via a dialogue system.  Here you will learn about various students, how they feel about you (as the character talking to them), and opinions of other characters from their perspective.  The sharp eyed player will also take note of  empty meter under your portrait.

[h2][b]MORE THAN JUST DIALOGUE, INVESTING IN RELATIONSHIPS ADDS TO COMBAT![/b][/h2]
Now, when you're in combat, you’ll discover a new object... a crate.  When you break a crate open, collectible items spill out of it.

Those collectibles are gifts that can be given to particular students back in Valorborn’s courtyard.  Give a character a gift they appreciate, and the relationship meter associated with their portrait will start to fill. Keep it up, and the romance meter will fill to the point where a threshold is passed, and you’ll notice that how they speak to you changes.  While some may mature into full blown romance, others may be more on the platonic end of friendship.

When you cross a certain relationship threshold with a character, they will also appear in combat to join you for a short time, bringing with them their primary weapons and possibly abilities too.  Keep improving that relationship, and they will stay for longer when they appear, and be progressively more powerful with each upgrade.  As with students in real life, some enjoy your company, while others... let's just say may take more work to get acquainted with.  All of this is for the new student to discover and find their place at Valorborn.

[h2][b]WHAT'S NEXT?[/b][/h2]
Keep in mind, this is the first edition of this feature, and there’s lots more we want to do with it, but we feel it’s important to get it in front of our players. We hope you enjoy the beginning of our newest feature!

[h2][b]AS ALWAYS WE THANK YOU![/b][/h2]
From all of the Necromantic devs, we hope you like the first intro to this new long asked for feature, and hope you continue to enjoy your time playing Necromantic!

notes.title: Developer Diaries: Entry 03
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983366/2acf863fd1d908a5626737782b4c1ffa5a7dfd8f.png[/img]

[h2][b]GREETINGS![/b][/h2]
Greetings fellow Necromantics!  Last week we were busy with some much needed patches to ensure everyone is enjoying their full experience.  This week we’ve been hard at work on the anticipated romance features.  We can’t say much about it right now, but we’re pretty excited to show everyone more from the Necromantic universe, so stay tuned.

[h2][b]FUTURE PATCHES[/b][/h2]
There have been a few assignment issues, and core gameplay tuning that the design department has been investigating, so we’ll have a patch(es) out as soon as possible.

[h2][b]DID YOU KNOW?[/b][/h2]
One of the discussions on steam brought up a question about playing Necromantic without internet.   If you are on Steam Offline mode, or have no internet connection, you can still take Necromantic to work on some assignments offline!  This is particularly great if you have a laptop, a Steam Deck, or handheld when you are traveling.  Note, that if you’re in airplane mode, this typically cuts out Bluetooth, so you’ll either have to manually toggle that, or be without your wireless controller or mouse.  Because you are offline, you will not be able to play Co-op mode for obvious reasons.

[h2][b]GAMEPLAY TIPS[/b][/h2]
We polled out dev team for gameplay tips, and here are a couple of gems that may help you navigate the Valorborn Academy assignments.
[list]
[*] When fending off the hordes, minimal movement often helps.  When rapidly moving around I sometimes tend to ‘freak out’ and make mistakes when trying to avoid an enemy, but instead end up smacking into it’s dangerous neighbour accidently.  Usually I keep still, aim (if using targetted fire) and always look for an exit lane, or an area where the hordes are less thick, and cut a path in that direction.  
[*] Elite enemies can drop pieces of cheese, as well as higher tier XP gems
[/list]
[h2][b]THANK YOU![/b][/h2]
From the Necromantic devs, we wish you a great week, and an even better time playing Necromantic!

notes.title: Developer Diaries: Entry 02
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983366/39fbee86dc0dce167c6ea78f899cba0633c152b2.png[/img]

[h2][b]2 DAYS AGO[/b][/h2]
What a whirlwind launch day! Our hard working devs had been burning the midnight oil to bring our Necromantic title to Early Access Launch two days ago.  Since then, you can see that we’ve NOT been idle, and have released multiple patches (one is scheduled in the next hour or so!) taking in all the excellent responses and feedback from you, our gaming public.  

[h2][b]HELPFUL TIPS[/b][/h2]
There are some items we’d like to help our Necromantic followers with.  We realize that we can and strive to communicate better with you about some mechanics we take for granted, playing and developing it intensively over the past few months.
[list]
[*] You can toggle on and off targeted aim with the middle mouse button or right shoulder button on controller
[*] While you start out with Robbie at the beginning, there are two more characters that can be unlocked through game progression.  Milo the Halfling, and Danica the Elf who are on the right side of the courtyard, on either side of the seated student.  You will need to unlock them however!  Who said the Valorborn school term was easy?
[*] Rest assured the dev team has more students waiting in the wings to take up night assignments, as three is just the beginning.
[*] Talking about unlocks, there are quite a few weapons, other than the ever popular Blessed Blade, Kitchen Knives and Fireshard that are available.  Some of the dev teams’ favourites will be unlocked, when you complete more school assignments.   Did we mention eventually you can have more than just 2 weapon slots?  SSSHHH!!!!!  That’s only for advanced students!
[*] Similarly, there are quite a number of abilities to discover, and once you unlock them, you will truly become an undead slaying valedictorian. 
[*] Many of you have traversed through a single night assignment.  But like school, you will truly need to tackle several assignments in order to make it to the top of your class. Yes, meta-progression will take some repeated runs and time to move forward.
[/list]
[h2][b]THANK YOU![/b][/h2]
From the bottom of our hearts, we thank you, and look forward to your continued support!

notes.title: Developer Diaries: Entry 01
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983366/1db9bf526e0220644e7c5a490f618602b286bbe5.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]LAUNCH DAY![/b][/h2]
Happy launch day! All of us at Blinkmoon want to take the opportunity to welcome everyone to the world of Necromantic. Launching a game is no easy task, so we are very proud to have launched our first as a studio.

As we progress through the first week of Early Access launch, we wanted to touch base with our 
community on a couple of topics:


[h2][b]BUG FIXING & GENERAL STABILITY[/b][/h2]
By far, our primary focus at the moment is ensuring that everyone can play the game. Please continue to report any weird in-game behavior or crashes on our Steam Discussions page (or Discord). We’re constantly refreshing both to see if there are any problems out there.

As of this morning, a couple of crash reports have come in and we’re already working on potential fixes. 

As we process and verify these fixes internally, we’ll be pushing Hotfixes to the live build.

Cavalry is on the way!


[h2][b]CO-OP[/b][/h2]
On to the topic of Co-Op - this is a feature that we want to support long-term, adding multiple sub-features that haven’t quite been tried within the genre (yet).

Additionally, we want to make sure that the base experience is as optimized and smooth as it possibly can be. Optimization is a challenge given the many edge cases that we have to take into consideration. We leverage a P2P network approach, which means that if you create a match, you are technically considered the host (while the joining player is the client).

The experience of Co-Op may vary depending on a number of factors, including:

[list]
[*] PC rig specs
[*] Distance between Host and Client
[*] General network stability & speed
[/list]

As a result of the many edge cases and the potential of a less than perfect experience, we’ve decided to commit to Co-Op as our main priority outside of bug fixing. Dates can certainly change, but we’re confident that we can dramatically improve the Co-Op experience and stabilize the various edge cases within the next couple of weeks.


[h2][b]BALANCING[/b][/h2]
Please provide your feedback! There are many games within the genre with many different play styles. We’ve tried our best to find our own little niche as an Auto Shooter, but at the end of the day, we’ll rely on our community to help provide us direction.

As a result, you’ll notice some balance changes being pushed in updates as the need arises. These may or may not go out with bug fixes, depending on the timing.


[h2][b]WHAT'S NEXT[/b][/h2]
Plenty. There are a lot of Quality of Life improvements in our backlog that, while we weren’t able to get to them for Early Access launch, we have a lot queued up for upcoming updates.

Just to throw out a few:
FTUE updates
Progression updates
Meta Feature Improvements

Additionally, we’ve got some pretty big things planned for the future (and much closer than you might expect).

We’d like to add a little bit more romance into the ‘Necromantic’ by introducing a new feature that will allow for far more intractability with the students and playable characters in the courtyard. Gifting, romance progress, and special unlocks are just a few of the things that we have in mind.

More on that later!

We value and respect all constructive feedback, and are constantly looking to improve the play experience.  Since we've launched on Early Access, a balancing patch update was released within hours, and we're busy in development on another patch over the next day or so to address some of the findings of our wonderful gameplay community

Again, we wanted to provide our sincere thanks to everyone who has taken the time to engage with us, provide feedback and support us as we’ve launched our first Early Access title!

As always, please fill out our [url=https://forms.gle/CLDtsSzhoTTECRd77]Player Survey [/url]to better help us improve Necromantic for you!

[i]Signed the Necromantic Development Team[/i]
